args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 production deploy, checkout-api began failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Follow-up: verify recovery and investigate the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident.

- **Cause:** Release v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. The test build of v2.3.1 had also failed in staging before it went to production.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions. A follow-up check shows the service healthy, with the error rate down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open as SEV2 for checkout-api, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback and the next steps: confirm the service has recovered and find out what broke in v2.3.1 before deploying it again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
